d:
I mostly picked this one out because I've been obsessive with formatting and cleaning lately. This one was almost entirely just easy "put the text in the bubble.", which was a welcome change.

If you don't see me for a month, don't be shocked. I just started on one where every single bubble is transparent, and requires extensive cleaning. Frankly, if you see me before July, it's probably because I got fed up and gave up to do something else.

Updated 6/1/26: Pushing an update to include the correction from rick-kun. I spent some time digging into the japanese, and I had somehow gotten tunnel vision and assumed that Rin had to be comparing Manami to herself. There was no such phrasing.
